description: Aeromexico Rewards points and qualifying points for a flight operated by Aeromexico. Points = 8 per US dollar of base fare (the ticket total minus taxes and fees, whole ticket), rounded down; qualifying points are the same, except Basic Economy (class V, fam BS), which earns points but no qualifying points. The level does not change the earning (the "additional accrual" Aeromexico lists by level prints no unit, so it is not added). Progress toward Silver (25,000), Gold (50,000), Platinum (80,000) and Titanium (100,000) qualifying points in a calendar year; qp is the qualifying points so far. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Aeromexico's own: delta = Delta SkyMiles (creditStatus one of: SkyMiles Member, Silver Medallion, Gold Medallion, Platinum Medallion, Diamond Medallion); flying-club = Flying Club (creditStatus one of: Red, Silver, Gold); flying-blue = Flying Blue (creditStatus one of: Explorer, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ultimate). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

fam.description: Fare family. BS = Basic Economy (class V); CL = Clasica (R N E T Q L H K U M B Y); AP = AM Plus (class W); PR = Premier or Premier One (I D C J). The fare family on your ticket. All of them earn 8 points per dollar; only Basic Economy (class V) earns no qualifying points.

price.description: Base fare in US dollars (whole ticket) in US dollars. The ticket total minus taxes and fees, for the whole ticket. If you paid in pesos, enter the equivalent in US dollars. Required unless creditTo is given.

qp.description: Qualifying points you have so far this year (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next level.

status.description: Your Aeromexico Rewards level. CL = Classic; SV = Silver; GD = Gold; PL = Platinum; TI = Titanium. Used only for the progress toward the next level. The earning is the same at every level.
